layer1.name: Gumroad
layer1.one_liner: A single link that lets a creator sell anything directly to their audience.
layer1.description: Sellers upload a file, set a price, share a link, and get paid, with the platform taking a percentage. Positioned against both marketplaces and full ecommerce stacks.
layer1.outcome_note: Reported $20.7M revenue and $8.9M net profit for 2023, publicly, by the founder. Notable as a company that nearly failed and was rebuilt as a small profitable business rather than a growth one.

sources.note: Founder's public disclosure of 2023 revenue and profit
